children: UPEXI, INC. reported fiscal 2026 results showing revenue of $25M and a net loss of $(246.1)M, with diluted loss per share of $(3.87), reflecting a significant increase in losses year over year amid a strategic pivot to digital assets.
Revenue was $25.0M for FY 2026 (Revenue $7.57M + Digital asset revenue $17.43M), down from $15.81M in FY 2025; YoY change (58.1%).
Net income (loss) was a loss of $(246.1)M for FY 2026, compared with a loss of $(13.7)M for FY 2025; increase in loss $232.4M YoY.
Diluted EPS (loss) was $(3.87) for FY 2026, compared with $(1.73) for FY 2025.
Revenue mix shifted materially as the company moved away from legacy consumer-product lines toward a digital-asset-focused strategy, driving a roughly 49% decline in traditional revenue.
Management reallocated treasury assets into Solana (SOL), increasing staking activity and digital-asset revenue, and the company holds 849,124 locked SOL tokens with scheduled unlocks through 2028.

UPEXI exited certain manufacturing and distribution operations, lowering cost of goods sold and distribution and sales/marketing spend, while increasing general and administrative expenses and stock-based compensation to build digital-asset capabilities and support public-company operations.
